name: Torgash Default
description: The engine's own storefront theme. Colours, fonts, the header and the blocks are all set in the configurator.

settings.label: Colour scheme
settings.help: What a visitor sees first. Their own choice with the sun/moon switch still wins.

settings.label: Logo
settings.help: On a light background. Without one the shop's name is written in its place. A wide picture about 80 px high reads best.

settings.label: Logo on a dark background
settings.help: For the dark header and the footer. Empty — the logo above is used there too.

settings.label: Picture for a product with no photo
settings.help: Your own placeholder — a logo on a plain background works well; square is best. Without one a quiet frame in the page's own colours is drawn. Never sent to feeds: a marketplace rejects placeholders.

settings.label: Second colour
settings.help: Badges and accents that are not the main action.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.help: A third colour for highlights: a badge, a marker.

settings.label: Header and footer colour
settings.help: The dark bars: the header in its dark style, the footer, the phone's header. Their text takes white or dark by itself, whichever reads.

settings.label: Success
settings.help: "In the basket", "Saved", a paid order.

settings.label: Error
settings.help: A field the form could not take, a refused payment.

settings.label: Price
settings.help: The price on cards, rows and the product page.

settings.label: Old price
settings.help: The struck-through price beside a discount. Paler than the price on purpose.

settings.label: Discount
settings.help: The "−20%" badge, "You save" and a set's lowered price.

settings.label: In stock
settings.help: Until you change it, it follows the base colour.

settings.label: Page background
settings.help: Behind the panels and cards, in the light scheme. The dark scheme keeps its own.
settings.style: :root[data-theme="torgash-light"] body.torgash-storefront { background-color: var(--torgash-page-bg); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) { :root:not([data-theme]) body.torgash-storefront { background-color: var(--torgash-page-bg); } }

settings.label: Dark scheme tone
settings.help: What the dark scheme’s panels, page and lines are tinted with. A dark colour typed for one of them still wins.

settings.label: Text colour
settings.help: The words on the page. Its dark twin rises until it reads on the dark page.

settings.label: Page: gradient or picture
settings.help: Behind the panels and cards. A picture covers the page; the colour above stays under it.

settings.label: Header: gradient or picture
settings.help: Each row of the header — the strip and the main row draw it on their own.

settings.label: Footer: gradient or picture
settings.help: Behind the footer's columns.

settings.label: Headings font
settings.help: A second font for the headings and the product names on their own pages; the rest stays in the font above.

settings.label: Site width
settings.help: The widest the page gets on a large screen, in pixels: 1024–1920.

settings.label: Header layout
settings.help: Two rows: a thin strip and a compact main row. Three rows: a taller main row with the icons signed, the strip of links above it.

settings.label: Header colours
settings.help: Dark takes the header and footer colour (Colours). Light takes the page's own, with a line under each row.

settings.label: Phone and contacts
settings.help: Where the block of the zone "Header — after the search box" stands: in the main row, or up in the thin strip beside the language and currency.

settings.label: Logo height on a computer
settings.help: For an uploaded logo. "The header's own" keeps the size the header style draws.

settings.label: Account menu in the header
settings.help: Short shows the orders, the wishlist and whatever has a number on it (unread replies, bonus points); the rest of the account opens under "All sections". The account page itself always lists everything.

settings.label: Keep the header on screen while scrolling
What stays on screen
settings.help: The main row is the logo, the search and the basket; the thin strip above it (town, language, currency) scrolls away with the page.

settings.label: The "Brands" button beside the catalogue
settings.help: Off — the search gets the room. Brands are one link away in the top strip either way.

settings.label: The "Catalogue" button in the header
settings.help: Off — when the strip under the header already holds the catalogue's departments.

settings.label: A quiet header on the cart and checkout pages
settings.help: The town, the logo and the contacts — no search, catalogue or menus, so nothing leads away from paying.

settings.label: A strip of top categories under the header
settings.help: A category that has subcategories opens them on hover. What does not fit in one row goes on to the next page of the strip (the "› 1/2" button).

settings.label: The strip stays on screen too
The "Catalogue" button opens
settings.help: A menu from Appearance → Menus. A category item there can open into its subcategories and show only those with something to buy.

settings.label: Links under a heading in the Catalogue menu
settings.help: A subcategory with subcategories of its own is a column: its name as the heading, its children under it. Past this many, "More" opens the rest. 0 — all of them.

settings.label: The strip under the header shows
Language switch in the header
settings.help: Drawn only when the storefront has more than one language.

settings.label: Currency switch in the header
settings.help: Drawn only when there is more than one currency.

settings.label: Picture shape
settings.help: The frame a product's photo is shown in, in every grid and carousel.

settings.label: Photo in the frame
settings.help: "Whole" never crops a product; "Fill" crops the edges so every card is covered — good for photos shot on a background.
settings.style: .torgash-card figure > img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: var(--torgash-card-fit); }

settings.label: Behind the photo
settings.help: What fills the frame around a photo that does not cover it. "Like the page" suits photos shot on white.

settings.label: Products in a row in the catalogue
settings.help: On a wide screen, beside the filters. Smaller screens fit as many as they can.

settings.label: The phone's header
settings.help: One row at the top of a phone screen. With the logo the search is one tap further away, the price of naming the shop on every screen.

options.search: The menu and the search field
options.search_mark: The search field with the shop's sign in it
options.logo: The logo and icons; the magnifier opens the search

settings.label: The shop's sign in the search field
settings.help: A square picture, 64 px or more. Empty — the first letter of the shop's name. Used by "The search field with the shop's sign in it".

settings.label: Phone icon in the header with the logo
settings.help: Dials the shop's phone from Settings → Contacts; not drawn when there is none.

settings.label: The bottom bar shows
settings.help: A menu from Appearance → Menus: shortcuts (the basket with its count, "open the catalogue"), pages and categories. The first five with an address are drawn; an entry without an icon gets a circle.

settings.label: Footer layout
settings.help: Columns: the bands and the columns side by side. Compact: no advantages band and less air. Centred: everything in one column down the middle.

settings.label: Footer colours
settings.help: Dark takes the colour of the header bar (Colours). Light takes the page's own, with a line above. A signature written with {logo_dark} wants {logo} on a light footer.

settings.label: Column widths
settings.help: On a computer, for the columns layouts. The columns are the zones that have blocks in them.

settings.label: Lines between the columns and the bands
The bottom line
settings.help: The shop's signature and the payment marks. The centred layout always centres it.

settings.label: Fold the menus on a phone
settings.help: Each menu column shows its title; the links open with the arrow beside it. Off — every link is on show, one long list.

settings.label: Your own CSS
settings.help: Printed after the theme's own styles, so it can change anything. Your own JavaScript goes into Code snippets (category "Necessary"), where consent is respected.

presets.name: Classic
presets.description: The theme as it ships: the dark bar, sky blue, Finlandica Text.

presets.name: Bright
presets.description: The light three-row header with a strip of categories, Golos Text.

presets.name: Soft
presets.description: Violet, round corners everywhere, Manrope, lighter headings — and the home page's products as carousels.

presets.name: Strict
presets.description: Square corners, the device's own font, a narrower page, blue.
